units.source_text: 對於懼怕這種怪談的我，雖然就像水往低處流一樣自然地肯定著唯物論，

en.t: Although I feared such ghost stories, I accepted materialism as naturally as water flows downhill,

units.source_text: 卻無法藉此擺脫對人類的恐懼，無法放眼綠葉感受到希望的喜悅。

en.t: yet it could not free me from my fear of human beings, nor could I look out at green leaves and feel the joy of hope.

units.source_text: 不過，我從未缺席地參加R.S（記得是這麼叫的，也許有誤）的聚會，

en.t: Even so, I never missed a meeting of R.S. (I think that was what it was called, though I may be wrong),

units.source_text: 「同志」們個個如商討天下大事，不苟言笑地繃著臉，

en.t: while the comrades, each as if discussing affairs of supreme importance, sat with solemn, rigid faces,

units.source_text: 沉浸於猶如「一加一等於二」之類的初等算術的理論研究中，此情此景的滑稽真讓人忍俊不禁。

en.t: absorbed in studying theories no more advanced than elementary arithmetic, like one plus one equals two; the absurdity of the scene was impossible not to laugh at.

units.source_text: 我以自己往日慣用的搞笑方式，活躍聚會的氣氛。

en.t: I used my usual clowning to lighten the atmosphere of the meeting.
